notes: This is a kit: 1 × P2S 3D Printer with AMS (the P2S Combo), 3 hotends, 4 PLA filaments and an LED kit. Every printer spec is the P2S's, from the P2S Spec Sheet, which the kit page links and whose table it shows.

product.net_weight is left out on purpose: no document states the kit's weight. The sheet's 14.9 kg is the P2S printer alone; the store table's 15.0 kg (P2S) and 16.4 kg (P2S Combo, AMS 2 Pro included) are other configurations, and the sheet and the store table already disagree for the printer (14.9 vs 15.0 kg). The deterministic page row ("15000 / 16400 g", unverified) stays; it is not the kit's weight.

shipment.gross_weight (18.58 / 21.33 kg) and package.length/width/height (490 × 490 × 560 mm) are on the US store table (us_110v, already in the payload) and describe the P2S / P2S Combo shipments, not the kit. No 220 V / UK package values exist in any searched source, so no intl_220v row and no CBM.
physical.recommended_space (500 × 500 × 950 mm) is on the store table and already in the payload as verified; the sheet does not carry it, so no curated row repeats it.

Left out on purpose (neither a spec nor not_published): thermal.chamber_temp (only the marketing heading "50°C Chamber Ready For Engineering-Grade Filaments."; marketing proves no number, and the FAQ says there is no active chamber heating), extrusion.hotend (the sheet names a "Standard Flow Hotend" only inside the Max Flow label; the page markets a "Quick Swap Hotend"), connectivity.interface (a USB port appears only inside the Storage row), printing.multi_color (the page row is a feature bullet), the dual-toolhead keys, printing.working_area, electrical.battery/connector/requirements, carton.*, identity.*, compat.statement, part.material, variant.note, package.volume_m3 and manufacturer_terms.*.
Marketing numbers not recorded: "up to 8.5 kg of maximum extrusion force", "70% more", "20 kHz", "60%" faster feeding, "30% faster" drying, "30-Second Nozzle Swap", "50°C Chamber".
No commercial, policy or warranty term from the page is recorded.
